note: Three commit identities that must never collapse into 'current HEAD'.
measuredCommit is the tree the acceptance suite actually executed.
evidenceRecordedBy is the commit that wrote the result down, which is
necessarily later and was NOT itself measured. reviewReferenceCommit is
the frozen review subject, which has never moved.
Every run below is a GitHub Actions matrix over Nix 2.34.7 and 2.24.9,
run cold: no NSE_TEST_REUSE, escrow/ created from nothing.

reviewReferenceCommit.note: The subject of the five review rounds. Has not moved and must not.

runs.verdict: observables still unchanged; the new assertion over-claimed and said so
note: REQUIRED_SOURCES_PRESENT_AFTER_BUILD stayed 4/4 after the null-counting fix,
so that count was correct all along -- it was just derived unsoundly.
FLAKE_INPUTS_PRESENT_AFTER_BUILD=2/4 is Nix behaving correctly: a locked
input is materialised when evaluation reaches it. t07.9a asserted all four
and was wrong. DESIGN.md 17c.

runs.judgedAgainst: DESIGN.md §17 as amended by §17a, both written before this commit
note: Every observable §17 pre-registered is unchanged from run 11, closureSha256
included. The single failure, on both legs, is t07.9: it asserted
.restoreExit == 0 -- the exit code of a `nix copy` the default path never
ran. Vacuous since `native` became the default, and detected only because
the deletion removed the field it was reading. Not a regression of the
system; a fifth instrument that could not go red.

runs.note: First run green on every step of both legs. The canonical Result section of EVIDENCE.md is this run's report.
The fixed probe named the outliers: 17 __structuredAttrs derivations carrying their attributes in env.__json.
The probe added to diagnose the gap ran `nix derivation show` without -r and measured its own invocation.
First fully green leg. All nine remaining failures were the one derivation-attribute finding.
Green t01-t19, then `find | head` + pipefail + set -e ended the suite before it could print a result.
Died in the binary tier. Root cause: `nix path-info --json` answers "path": null and exits 0, and the parser read keys[].

The first real execution, 2026-09-03. A pre-fix DIAGNOSTIC BUNDLE, never canonical evidence: its binaryTier numbers were produced by the presence parser fixed in run 7's commit. Runs 1-4 are not indexed here; their identifiers were not recorded at the time.

note: E0-E3 were retired together with the two mechanisms they toggled, because
the experiment's independent variable was those mechanisms. DESIGN.md 17a.
These are their final values, frozen as the justification for the deletion.
A measurement cannot be both the reason for a change and its acceptance test.
retiredAtCommit is the commit that DELETED them, recorded by a later commit; the same measured/recorded split as run 11's measuredCommit vs evidenceRecordedBy.

hypotheses.E2: no manual flake-input restore; Nix must substitute locked inputs itself
hypotheses.E3: both dropped: what the tool shipped as its default
